provenance.fitted_on: multi-source validation: APTOS val + DDR valid (n=3052); seed 42
provenance.t_refer: highest P(referable) threshold with validation sensitivity >= 0.95
provenance.t_entropy: smallest entropy cut-off where accepted validation cases reach sensitivity >= 0.97 with abstention <= 30%
provenance.t_ood: 99th percentile of Mahalanobis distance (PCA-64 of CNN features) on validation
provenance.lesion_suspicious: 97th percentile of lesion-candidate area/count among validation grade 0-1 images
provenance.temperatures: temperature scaling per grader, minimising validation NLL
provenance.never_used: IDRiD is never used for training, fitting or thresholds (fully external test)
provenance.laterality_disc_right: measured on DeepDRiD (n=1163 decided): disc on image right -> OD
